notMonitoringText:
Please install the Instana agent on the systems you want to monitor. Installation instructions are available in our [online documentation][Docs].

Should you need additional assistance, please contact us via our [support portal][Support].

[Docs]:https://instana.com/docs/setup_and_manage/
[Support]:https://support.instana.com
noData:
Instana is currently receiving data from agents but has no data for the selected time range.
Please select a different time range: e.g. [the last hour].

Should you need additional assistance, please contact us via our [support portal][Support].

[Docs]:https://instana.com/docs/setup_and_manage/
[Support]:https://support.instana.com
noDataFoundForTheQueryAtTheSelectedMomen: No data found for the query {{nextPropsQuery}} at the selected moment: *{{time}}*.
noDataFoundForTheQuery: No data found for the query {{nextPropsQuery}}.
noLogicalViewData: No traces available. The logical view shows the communication, relations and KPIs for discovered Services. The basis for this are traces. Please review the documentation or contact support for more information about the supported technologies and frameworks
customGroupingExample: Group hosts by defining a prefix which is used to define the group. For example a host tagged as group=demo can be placed into the zone demo using the prefix group=.
rearrangeZonesAsACompactStructure: Rearrange zones as a compact structure
enableAggregations: Enable time window based metric aggregations
